content: वरूथम् [वृ-ऊथन् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 6</ls>] .²1 A sort of wooden fence or fender with which a chariot is provided as a defence against collision ({%m.%} also in this sense); वरूथो रथगुप्तिर्या तिरोधत्ते रथस्थितिम्; चक्रैः षोडशभिर्युक्तं सवरूथं सकूबरम् <ls>A. Rām. 6. 11. 2</ls>. .²2 An armour, a coat of mail. .²3 A shield. .²4 A group, multitude, an assemblage; मथ्यमानात्तथा सिन्धोर्देवासुरवरूथपैः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 7. 16</ls>, <ls n="Bhāg.">3. 1. 28</ls>. .²5 Protection. .²6 A family. .²7 A house, residence (<ab>Ved.</ab> in the last 3 senses) .{@-थः@} .²1 The cuckoo. .²2 Time.
